summary: Backend-only testing of POST /api/public/site/inbound endpoint for receiving published content from CEO AI. All 13 tests passed (100%), covering: authentication (401 for missing/wrong/empty secret), upsert operations (create new, update existing, validation), delete operations (delete existing, 404 for non-existent, 404 for already deleted), and edge cases (slug-only, remote_entry_id-only, complex sections array, delete by slug).
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint correctly validates X-Site-Publish-Secret header against SITE_PUBLISH_SHARED_SECRET env var
Indexes created on startup for remote_entry_id and slug (unique, sparse) - good for performance
MongoDB _id properly excluded from responses using {'_id': 0} projection
Delete operation returns full entry data with deletion markers (deleted:true, deleted_at, operation:delete)
seed_data_creation: Test entries created with unique UUIDs during testing (prefixed with test-create-, test-update-, test-delete-, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/public/site/inbound endpoint fully functional. Tests cover all 4 requested scenarios: 401 without secret, upsert creates/updates, delete removes entry, 404 on delete non-existent. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_site_inbound.py -v
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - No issues found. Endpoint implementation is correct and all tests pass.
